entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We will be parting ways tomorrow.[n]I pray both trips go safely.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank you. Take care of[n]yourself, Yusuke.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And Futaba, we'll be relying[n]on you for the analysis.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Just let us know if[n]anything comes up, k?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Then off we go! Look[n]after Morgana for us.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You guys are still talking about that trip...?
